profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: A recent graduate of the University of Colorado Boulder with a degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering. My concentrations are in Power Electronics and Embedded Systems. I have strong circuit analysis and debugging skills as well as very strong programming skills in C/C++.

projects.title: Mariah Bot
projects.description: Created a robot that was controlled via Bluetooth that delivered holiday treats and drinks. Configured UART, SPI, and ADC drivers.

projects.title: Rdraw
projects.description: RDraw is a web-based application that randomly pairs people online to facilitate a “whiteboard'' like communication. Software used to complete project was SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
